title: A Stranger at the Gate
text: A traveller in rift-stained mail stands at one House's door in the sleet and asks for shelter. Their armor is scored by claws. They will not give a name, and when they speak they cast no breath on the cold air. The dogs have gone under the stairs.

outcomes.text: The stranger swears to the House and asks to be taught. They never take off the mail.
In the night the stranger is gone, and so is a strongbox. The bed they slept in is cold as a grave.

options.label: Admit them under guard, and ask questions.

outcomes.text: They talk, eventually, about what lies past the Gate, in a voice that does not move their lips.
They say nothing at all, and at dawn the guards find only the mail, empty and still buckled.

options.label: Turn them back into the sleet.

outcomes.text: They walk off into the dark without a word. The dogs follow them to the edge of the fields and will not come back.
